title: Additive Manufacturing of Metals
author: National Institute of Standards and Technology
relevance: Official measurement-science treatment of metal additive manufacturing, process monitoring, material characterization, qualification, and standards needs.

title: 3D Printing with Metal Powders: Health and Safety Questions to Ask
author: National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health
relevance: Official guidance on inhalation, dermal, fire, explosion, ventilation, containment, housekeeping, and worker-protection concerns in metal-powder additive manufacturing.

title: General Requirements for All Machines
author: Occupational Safety and Health Administration
relevance: Official machine-guarding requirements for points of operation, rotating parts, flying chips, sparks, and other manufacturing hazards.

title: CHIPS for America Metrology Program
author: National Institute of Standards and Technology
relevance: Official overview of fit-for-purpose measurement, process monitoring, prediction, quality, and yield challenges in advanced semiconductor manufacturing and packaging.

title: Metrology for the Next Generation of Semiconductor Devices
author: Ndubuisi G. Orji et al.
relevance: Review of dimensional metrology, device complexity, lithography, heat dissipation, carrier mobility, fault tolerance, and measurement limits for advanced integrated circuits.

title: Critical Dimension and Overlay Metrology
author: Michael T. Postek and Marylyn H. Bennett
relevance: Institutional treatment of critical-dimension and layer-overlay measurement in semiconductor fabrication and the role of traceable standards.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
author: National Institute of Standards and Technology
relevance: Lifecycle framework for governing, mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks to individuals, organizations, and society.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
author: Chloe Autio et al.
relevance: Cross-sector guidance on generative-AI risks, evaluation, governance, content provenance, information integrity, privacy, security, and human oversight.

title: RFC 9293: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP)
author: Internet Engineering Task Force
relevance: Current standards-track specification for TCP segment processing, reliability mechanisms, connection behavior, and implementation requirements.

title: Framework for Cyber-Physical Systems: Volume 1, Overview
author: National Institute of Standards and Technology
relevance: Framework for integrated digital, analog, physical, and human components, including timing, trustworthiness, data, boundaries, composition, and lifecycle concerns.

title: SP 800-82 Rev. 2: Guide to Industrial Control Systems Security
author: National Institute of Standards and Technology
relevance: Guidance for securing SCADA, distributed control, PLC, and other industrial-control environments while preserving safety, reliability, and real-time performance.

title: Grid Modernization Initiative
author: United States Department of Energy
relevance: Official program addressing grid integration, distributed generation, storage, resilience, security, reliability, and modernization across technical and institutional layers.
